thread:
Sam: Heads up — macos bazel CI started failing on the new gcc image roll, looks like objcopy is missing in the container. job: macos-release-x64-14

Sam: Error snippet:```
/usr/bin/ld: warning: objcopy not found, unable to strip symbols
sh: 1: objcopy: not found
Target //pkg:agent failed to build
"BUILD" failed: //pkg:agent:link: Linking of rule '//pkg:agent:agent_bin' failed (Exit 127)
```

Lee: ugh. which image tag did the infra roll use?

Sam: it shows `gcc-13.1-2026-03-15` in the job env. The linux images have binutils, macos image seems to have dropped it from the new base.

Jordana: can you paste the full job URL? I'll repro locally quick.

Sam: https://ci.redwood-internal/run/49827 — repro steps I ran: `bazel build //pkg:agent --config=macos-release` inside the image. Same error.

Alex: quick workaround: add `--strip=never` or skip `strip` step in the genrule until we fix the image. Not ideal for release builds though. :grimacing:

Lee: tagging @Infra CI Bot to rerun the job after a quick fix? Infra CI Bot: please rerun 49827 with previous image tag `gcc-13.0-2026-02-28` and also run a one-off with `brew install binutils` in setup to confirm.

Infra CI Bot: scheduled rerun: 49827-rerun-prev-image (queued). Status will post here. :robot_face:

Jordana: if the previous image works, we should pin the macos image in the short term and open a toolchain rollback PR. I'll also file a CI ticket.

Sam: created issue INFRA-1249 with logs and link. Moving forward we should add a smoke test that checks for `objcopy` and `strip` presence during image build.

Lee: Agreed. Sam, can you/ Alex add the smoke test? I can cut the pin PR if rerun passes.

Alex: I can add a tiny `which objcopy && which strip` check in the image build script, will open PR shortly.

Infra CI Bot: rerun complete — prev-image run passed. Artifact: https://ci.redwood-internal/artifact/49827/prev-image-pass

Sam: great — Lee please proceed with pin PR. Jordana, can you add the smoke test ticket to the sprint?

Jordana: on it. I'll link INFRA-1249 to the sprint board.

Lee: PR: infra/ci#432 pinned macos image back to `gcc-13.0-2026-02-28` and added a follow-up TODO. PTAL everyone.

Sam: thx. We'll keep the bucket open for the image owner to reintroduce binutils properly. :thumbsup:

Alex: opened image-build PR to add `binutils` and a smoke check: infra/images#178 — includes local test logs.

Jordana: moving this to postmortem/status later if the image owners want an RCA. For now the pin + smoke check reduces flakiness.

Sam: resolving here. If anyone sees related macos link failures, ping me and I'll triage.
